title: Roast cherry tomato dip with trout

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole food or plain staple, such as cherry tomatoes, garlic, trout, Greek yoghurt and raw veg.

supermarket.reason: Cherry tomatoes, trout fillets, Greek yoghurt and crudité veg are everyday supermarket items at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray and a stick blender, and the techniques are simple.

works.reason: Blending 500g of juicy roasted cherry tomatoes, with no draining or reducing, into only 150g yoghurt (still warm, so it may split) gives a thin sauce rather than a dip that will cling to veg sticks.

honest_times.reason: 15 minutes of active work covers the veg sticks, blending and flaking, and the 30 minutes of cook time matches 15 + 10 minutes of roasting plus 5 of cooling.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps and nothing unlisted appears, though the step says 'paprika' where the list says smoked paprika.

seasonal_feel.reason: Roast cherry tomatoes with raw radishes and cucumber suit early June, and the tomatoes are the body of the dip.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are plain, brief British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a vegetable-heavy snack with trout and yoghurt for protein, which a family would happily eat.
